name: Forest bamboo shoot
summary: Forest bamboo shoot is a spring plate at Bản Đôn. Boiled, it starts bitter and leaves a sweet aftertaste.
origin: Bản Đôn, Pù Luông. Sources: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 18 Mar 2022; VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023.
taste: Bitter at first, then a sweet aftertaste.
howToEat: Boiled, in spring. Thai cooks also sour the shoot into măng chua for fish soup through the year.
where: The stilt-house meal at Bản Đôn.
seoTitle: Forest bamboo shoot in Pu Luong — bitter, then sweet
seoDescription: Măng rừng is the spring bamboo shoot of Bản Đôn. Boiled, it starts bitter and finishes sweet.
